node.statement: The block expansion W_{gamma,sigma}^dagger tensor W_{gamma,sigma}=sum_{r,s}sigma_r sigma_s iota_r(U^{(r),dagger}_{a_r b_r}) tensor iota_s(U^{(s)}_{a_s b_s}), after sign averaging, retains only r=s. For fixed r, summing the independent gamma coordinates outside r cancels their factors d_u^(-2), while the r-coordinate gives d_r^(-2)sum_{a_r,b_r}U^{(r),dagger}_{a_r b_r} tensor U^{(r)}_{a_r b_r}=D_{d_r}; therefore D=sum_r iota_r tensor iota_r(D_{d_r}).
